# drowsy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modeDrowsy`](gmeow-modeDrowsy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modeDrowsy>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The hypnagogic transitional state between waking and sleep — reduced arousal and attention, sleep onset imminent. Distinct from full sleep: perception is degraded but not absent.
